metadata.title: Belgian municipalities — equal-square tile grid (tilegram)
metadata.description: One equal-size square per Belgian municipality, placed on a gap-free grid by an optimal assignment minimising distance to each municipality's true centroid. Squares are uniform; position is geographic, not area- or population-weighted.
metadata.source: Boundaries: officiel_belgium.geojson (2025, 565 communes; 13 merged communes filled from Statbel statistical sectors 2025). Population: Statbel TF_SOC_POP_STRUCT 2025 (CC BY 4.0).

fields.displacement_km: distance from tile centre to true centroid
